cases.name: Skip_Advances_The_Caret_And_Charges_Full_Mistakes
cases.reason: Radha has no Skip API; the skip happens through space mid-word (word-aligned matcher). Skipped letters are Missing errors (3 full) but are NOT typed characters: Golu counts each skipped slot as a keystroke (TypingSession.cs SkipMarker, TotalKeystrokes++), which inflates gross WPM and KDPH. Radha characters_typed = 4 (o, r, a, space).

cases.name: A_Skipped_Word_Is_Reported_By_What_Was_Actually_Typed#word_level
cases.reason: Radha's word-level vocabulary (mistake.rs WordMistake, EXAM-MODE plan 5.4: omission full; case, spacing, spelling half) calls a word with a dropped letter a Spelling mistake. Golu labels the row with its character-level kind, "Missing Character" (Radha's unit-level kind for it is Missing, asserted in the previous case).

cases.name: A_Skip_Is_Unwound_By_Backspace_Like_Any_Other_Mistake
cases.reason: One backspace removes the one key pressed (the space), and the stateless matcher re-evaluates: the skip is fully undone with ONE backspace. Golu stores a marker per skipped slot and needs three backspaces.

cases.name: Skipping_The_Final_Word_Completes_The_Passage
cases.reason: Radha auto-completes only when the end is reached with a correct final unit (session.rs); a space inside the final word leaves Missing + Extra outcomes and the typist can still correct it. Time-up or submit end the session. Golu completes on the skip.
